text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find out where the problem is and what causes it. Fortunately, there are many debugging tools that can help you. For example, you can use a debugger to pause your program and check the values of variables. It is also helpful to follow a systematic approach. Instead of changing code randomly, test one thing at a time. Another useful technique is logging, which means adding print statements to see what your program is doing. With patience and practice, you can solve most bugs quickly.
